notes.title: Next Update December 1st! Adding Amsterdam Schiphol!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.bigfatsimulations.com/imageHost/schiphol.jpg[/img]

Hi folks!  Although I'm hard at work on the 3D version of Airport Madness for January, I fully intend to continue maintaining and expanding Airport Madness: World Edition.  The next update comes on December 1st, and will add Amsterdam Schiphol airport.  I also plan to fix many game bugs.

notes.title: Major Updates Since Release
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Airport Madness: World Edition!  Since our May 28 release, we've made major changes, most notably the addition of Barcelona Airport, Spain.  We've also:

[list]
    [*]Added several achievements
    [*]Added trading cards
    [*]Added clouds
 [*]Added aircraft data tags
 [*]Enlarged the viewing space to full-screen
 [*]Added an Options page
 [*]Did we mention the addition of Barcelona Airport?
[/list] 

If you haven't downloaded Airport Madness: World Edition yet, it's on sale at 25% off until August 10th, 2015!

Barcelona Airport:

[img]http://www.bigfatsimulations.com/imageHost/barcelona.jpg[/img]

notes.title: More Airports Coming!
notes.content:
Airport Madness continues to expand, with free new airports added regularly.  The next update will be online on June 25th, and will include Barcelona Airport, Spain.

We've recently added 8 new achievements to Airport Madness: World Edition, bringing the total number of achievements to 34!  In addition, we've added trading cards and badges to our game.  If you're not familiar with how trading cards work, you should definitely read the FAQ on them!  They are good time-wastin' fun! http://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/faq/

We've also squashed many game bugs with 1.34:

 [list]
    [*]Numpad support
    [*]ESC key now toggles full screen / windowed mode
    [*]Funchal traffic waiting to bactrack runway: extra room added
 [*]Enlarged the Funchal departure holding bay
 [*]Honolulu and San Francisco traffic jams: paths adjusted
 [*]Vancouver north apron, middle gate: increased clearance from next aircraft
 [*]Made Funchal "Move 100" challenge slightly easier
 [*]Prevented music from stopping all by itself
 [*]Reversed speed control on keyboard (1=slow, 2=fast)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.33 Available
notes.content:
We've added 26 Steam achievements!  We'd like to bring you even more, so please give us your ideas!  

We've also added a full-screen toggle button, so players can go back-and-forth between viewing options.

We're hoping to add trading cards very soon!
